text: あんた　オーキドの　ジジイに　かわいがられてる　こだね！

structure.jp: オーキドの　ジジイに　かわいがられてる　こだね！
structure.en: are the kid that old geezer Oak dotes on, aren't you!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ジジイに　かわいがられてる
patterns.explanation: られ turns the verb around so it is done to someone, and に shows who does it. ジジイに　かわいがられてる = 'is doted on by the old geezer'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かわいがられてる　こ
patterns.explanation: The words before こ describe which kid it is. かわいがられてる　こ = 'the kid who is doted on'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, showing something that keeps being so. かわいがられてる = 'is being doted on'.
